verdict.rationale: Entra ID offers rule-driven automation inside the identity domain. Conditional Access applies if-then policies on sign-in events (e.g., accessing Microsoft 365 requires MFA). Lifecycle Workflows run processes automatically against users as they move through joiner/mover/leaver phases, and SCIM provisioning automatically syncs users into apps. However, these are fixed, purpose-built identity automations rather than a general rule engine where you choose arbitrary events and actions. Missing for 10: general-purpose custom event triggers and actions, documented trigger and condition configuration detail for workflows, outbound webhooks/event subscriptions, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
